items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 24 June 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure covers Britain and Ireland.


##Wind##

North 2 to 4, settling east or southeast 3 or 4 later tonight or tomorrow morning, occasionally 5 in the southeast of the area and on western coasts of the Isle of Man, becoming 3 to 5 on Thursday evening.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 3 to 5, veering south 4 or 5, occasionally 6 for a time overnight into Friday, becoming variable 3 or 4 by Friday morning, then increasing southerly 4 to 6 Friday afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Smooth or slight, building slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Fair, then scattered showers developing, mist and fog patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling poor or very poor in mist and fog patches later.
